definitions: To allow the existence, occurrence, or practice of (something that one does not necessarily like or agree with) without interference or opposition.
To put up with (something or someone unpleasant or difficult) patiently.
To be able to withstand exposure to (something harmful or unpleasant) without ill effect.
examples: She can tolerate the cold weather.
I cannot endure his constant complaining.
The plants tolerate dry conditions well.
